headline: Executive order on the President's Council on Physical Fitness and Sports, a White House advisory group on exercise and sports.
what_it_does: This 2002 order deals with the President's Council on Physical Fitness and Sports, a group that advises the President on physical activity, fitness, and sports. The title is the only official detail provided, so the exact changes to the council's setup, members, or duties cannot be confirmed here. Advisory councils like this one usually make recommendations and run public awareness efforts rather than create binding rules.

who_it_affects.group: Members of the President's Council on Physical Fitness and Sports
who_it_affects.how: The order sets out or updates how the council is organized and what it is asked to do.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed June 6, 2002; executive orders usually take effect when signed.
